transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. I’m Dr. [Name]. Can you tell me what’s been bringing you in today?

Hi... um. I guess I'm here because I've been having some trouble lately. 

After I eat, I... well, I keep making myself throw up. Sometimes I do it in the bathroom at work, or... right when I get home. I just... I hate doing it, but... it kind of feels like the only way I can calm down now.
Do you feel very worried or preoccupied about your weight or the shape of your body?

Um... yeah. I guess so. 

I just... if the scale goes up even a little bit, or... if my waistband feels tight under my work apron... I panic. It just feels like I've ruined everything, and... and I'll be fat by the end of the day. So... yeah.
Do you ever find yourself eating a lot in one sitting, like feeling out of control while eating, even if it's not all at once?

Yeah... I guess. 

Um... it's hard to explain. Just... once I start, it feels like my hands just keep reaching for food. Even if I'm... even if I'm telling myself to stop. It's like I'm just watching myself do it, and... I can't make myself quit.
Besides making yourself vomit, do you ever use laxatives, diuretics, or exercise excessively to try to control your weight?

Um... no, not laxatives or anything. Just... 

On days after I eat too much, I try to make up for it by... well, I just don't eat until really late. And... I guess I exercise. I walk a lot. Even when my legs already hurt from standing at the cleaners all day, I just... I make myself keep going. Just to make up for it.

latest_inference.note: The patient's symptoms of self-induced vomiting after eating, preoccupation with weight and body shape, episodes of feeling out of control while eating, and compensatory behaviors such as fasting and excessive exercise strongly support a diagnosis of anorexia nervosa, binge-eating/purging type (F50.2). No other eating disorder subtypes or related conditions (e.g., bulimia nervosa or unspecified eating disorder) remain as likely given the current clinical picture.
